name: What is the process for unattended death cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for unattended death cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleanup process typically begins with a thorough assessment of the scene to identify all contaminated areas. Technicians then don specialized PPE and use containment procedures to prevent cross-contamination. Biohazardous materials are safely removed and disposed of according to strict regulations. The affected area is then cleaned, disinfected, and deodorized using industrial-grade solutions and equipment to eliminate odors and pathogens. Finally, the site is often tested to ensure complete remediation and safety before clearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves scene assessment, biohazard removal and disposal, deep cleaning, disinfection, and deodorization. Final testing ensures complete remediation and safety.
